messages:
aria: HelioHealth POC reporting intermittent SSE stream corruption from our Android SDK during staging demos. Truncated events -> JSON parse errors. Can someone triage?

samir: Which SDK version and platform? Android native?

aria: Android SDK v0.9.3 native. Fail rate ~10-20% on staging devices. Repro: start convo, wait 10-40s, stream cuts mid-event and client throws parse error.

priya: paste client error + server logs, and route/model.

aria: client: "org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object at character 1023"
route: POST /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b
server log:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:11Z INF client=helio/staging conn=abcd1234 bytes_sent=6248
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_event_end="\\n\\n"
```

josh: Looks like we cut mid-event. Likely proxy/CDN flushes splitting UTF-8 multibyte sequences. Two options: client-side incremental UTF-8 decoder + buffer until event delimiter, and server-side sentinel event to guarantee safe boundaries.

samir: I can hotflip a per-route flag send_fragment_sentinel=true to append `event: fragment_end\\ndata: {\"last\":true}\\n\\n` after logical chunks. Low risk.

priya: i'll open runtime ticket to add config and UI; also SDK ticket to harden Android decoder.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) priority=P1 owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio]

samir: toggled sentinel for helio-staging at 2026-03-18T15:12Z. Also recommending route-level keepalive=15s to avoid proxy idle flushes.

aria: customer ran 25 sessions after toggle: no parse exceptions on direct edge; CDN path failures dropped dramatically. Demo tomorrow still on.

kendall-sales: good — i'll update Helio: low-risk server toggle applied, SDK guidance and timeline incoming. Also will present dedicated capacity pricing as option.

aria: closing loop with customer, scheduling post-demo follow-up. Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
